description: Starter retrieval golden set for the 3-company pilot corpus (latest 10-K). Each query is labeled by an 'evidence' substring: a chunk is relevant iff it contains that substring (case-insensitive). Transparent and reproducible; to be expanded and hand-audited as the corpus grows. Queries are phrased as analyst questions, not copies of the evidence, to fairly test semantic retrieval.

queries.query: What risks does the company face in producing its hardware and depending on component suppliers?
Who are the main competitors to Microsoft Azure in cloud infrastructure?
How is Microsoft embedding generative AI capabilities across its products?
What drove the year-over-year change in Xbox and gaming revenue?
Why is switching or adding new suppliers costly and slow for Apple?
How much of Microsoft's contracted revenue has not yet been recognized?
How does stock-based compensation affect operating expenses?
What factors caused gross margin to increase?
How did research and development spending change and why?
How is the business exposed to climate change and related regulation?
